What is Runway?

Generative video and creative suite used in professional film and advertising production. Combines text-to-video and image-to-video generation with a deep toolkit of AI editing utilities - rotoscoping, motion tracking, inpainting and camera control.

Best for

Professional video generation and AI-assisted post-production.

Main features

  • Gen-4 and Gen-4 Turbo video models with strong character and scene consistency
  • Act-One for performance capture driving generated characters
  • camera control and motion brush
  • Frames image model
  • Magic Tools (green screen/rotoscope, inpainting, super-slow-motion, depth of field, background removal)
  • video-to-video restyling
  • Aleph editing model
  • custom voice and lip sync
  • team workspaces.

Practical use cases

  • Generating B-roll and establishing shots that would cost a location shoot
  • previsualisation and animatics
  • rotoscoping without manual keyframing
  • restyling footage
  • extending a shot
  • creating impossible camera moves.

Who is it for?

  • Filmmakers, VFX artists, advertising creatives, music video directors and post-production studios.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription; enterprise licensing

Plans described in the source

Free with roughly 125 one-time credits (no monthly refresh). Standard around $15/mo ($12 annually, 625 credits/month). Pro around $35/mo ($28 annually, 2,250 credits plus unlimited generations in Explore mode). Unlimited around $95/mo ($76 annually) with unlimited relaxed-rate generation. Enterprise custom, annual, with higher resolution, team management and indemnification. Additional credits purchasable at roughly $10 per 1,000.

Free plan

Yes - a one-time free credit allowance on signup, not a recurring free tier.

Free trial

The one-time free credits serve as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered: video generation costs credits per second of output, with higher-quality models and longer clips costing substantially more. Free tier credits are one-time, not monthly. Generation length is capped per clip (typically 5-10 seconds, extendable).

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The most professionally credible video generator here - used in actual film and advertising production
  • the Magic Tools suite (rotoscoping, motion tracking) delivers value even without generation
  • Act-One performance capture is genuinely novel
  • Gen-4 character consistency across shots is the best available.

Limitations to consider

  • Expensive at any real production volume - credits evaporate quickly
  • clip length limits still force stitching for anything narrative
  • free tier is one-time only, so evaluation is limited
  • output resolution and frame rate lag conventional production standards
  • generation is non-deterministic so achieving a specific shot takes many attempts and many credits.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS
  • API

Languages

  • English interface; prompts primarily English

API access

Yes - Runway API for Gen-4 and other models, priced per generation

Integrations and exports

  • Adobe Premiere Pro (export workflows), API, Frame.io-compatible export

Evaluation notes

Budget by seconds of usable output, not by generations - the accept rate on generated video is low and every attempt costs credits. The Magic Tools alone can justify the Standard tier for post-production work.
